tbesh_html:
1) to honour, adorn, glorify, be high
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to swell
1a1a) swelling (pass participle)
1a2) to honour, pay honour to, show partiality
1a3) to adorn
1a3a) adorned (pass participle)
1b) (Niphal) to be honoured
1c) (Hithpael) to honour oneself, claim honour

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to swell up (literally or figuratively, active or passive); by implication, to favor or honour, be high or proud
strongs_1890.kjv_def: countenance, crooked place, glorious, honour, put forth.
